snippet.title: Terrible Laboratory - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A pretty and talented scientist, Konica Yaegaki, must earn money to save her laboratory from competing companies and peers who seek to destroy her reputation. However, she won't go down that easily. Follow Konica in this Slice of Life RPG as she tries to save her laboratory!

On Steam:
http://bit.ly/2NDC6sD

Developer: Aburasobabiyori
Publisher: Kagura Games
